data.headline: Senior Security Architect @ Dominion Energy | M365, Endpoint Management (SCCM/MECM,Intune) Azure, EntraID,Purview DLP,Defender
data.about: With over 15 years of experience, I contribute to enterprise-scale infrastructure design and implementation.My work focuses on architecting and supporting cloud-based infrastructure while modernizing end-user computing with technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Purview and Defender Skilled in PowerShell and CI/CD, I enable process automation and enhance security while driving cost savings and reliability. Dedicated to aligning technology with organizational goals, I aim to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions for cloud-based deployments.

description.text:
Primary M365 Security Architect for a CEII-regulated energy organization, driving enterprise data protection, threat detection, endpoint governance, Zero Trust, compliance, and secure AI enablement.
•     Spearheaded enterprise M365 security architecture across Purview DLP, MIP, Defender XDR, Endpoint DLP, Insider Risk, and Zero Trust.
•     Designed M365 Purview DLP for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and endpoints, aligning CEII controls with response workflows.
•     Built M365 data classification using sensitivity labels, auto-labeling, encryption, SITs, EDM, and trainable classifiers.
•     Operationalized Defender XDR across Endpoint, Office 365, and Identity to strengthen detection, alert tuning, and investigations.
•     Expanded M365 Endpoint DLP to USB, print, clipboard, browser upload, and cloud sync channels for secure hybrid work.
•     Advanced Zero Trust with Conditional Access, MFA, least privilege, device trust, and compliance-based access enforcement.
•     Established M365 Copilot readiness by assessing label coverage, oversharing risk, prompt protection, and Purview AI governance.
•     Automated M365 DLP validation, label audits, compliance reporting, and incident triage using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.
•     Pioneered M365 Copilot for IT operations, accelerating scripting, triage, and runbooks while reducing documentation time ~40%.
•     Delivered Windows 11 migration for 300+ endpoints with Intune and Autopilot, cutting imaging time ~70% across 8+ sites.
•     Modernized endpoint operations with SCCM, Intune MDM/MAM, Autopatch, passwordless auth, Conditional Access, and ServiceNow automation.
•     Advised legal, compliance, executive, and security leaders on M365 architecture, CEII risk, governance, and audit readiness.

Responsible for architecting, designing, & implementing cloud-based infrastructure and endpoint management solutions using AWS and Azure. My work centers on building secure, scalable ,& modern device management that keep enterprises resilient and efficient. Specialize in End User Computing (EUC); automation with PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD; and defense-in-depth using Intune, SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Defender.
My portfolio includes architecting & managing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) infrastructures, leading end-to-end endpoint operations, and creating automation-driven solutions that improve performance and reduce operational overhead.
Core Responsibilities
•Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering: Design & implement secure, scalable cloud environments leveraging Azure and AWS, using IaC tools like ARM templates and CloudFormation.
•Endpoint Management & EUC Modernization: Drive modernization with Intune, SCCM/MECM, Autopilot, and Hybrid Azure AD Join.
•	Automation & DevOps Integration: Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, and integrate CI/CD pipelines.
•	Security & Compliance Enforcement: Implement Defender, Purview, DLP, EDR, BitLocker, and enforce compliance policies.
•	Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Management: Design & deploy AVD environments, configure FSLogix profiles, and optimize performance.
•	Endpoint Operations & Service Reliability: Lead end-to-end operations, resolve escalations, and align with ITIL processes.
Key Achievements
•Implemented EUC modernization with Intune, SCCM, Entra, and Cloud PC, improving resilience and reducing costs by 20%.
•	Accelerated provisioning for 15,000+ endpoints via Intune Autopilot and Hybrid Azure AD Join, cutting deployment time by 40%.
•	Designed, implemented, and supported Azure Virtual Desktop environments, ensuring secure, scalable, and high-performance virtual workspace delivery.
•Configured and maintained Group Policy and Active Directory structures, including OU management and compliance enforcement.

Architecting, designing, implementing and supporting of cloud based infrastructure and its solutions. Managing Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure with automation. Providing Operations Support in AWS services like VPC, EC2, S3, ELB, AutoScalingGroups(ASG), EBS, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudFront, CloudTrail.Creating multiple VPC’s and public, private subnets as per requirement and distributed them as groups into various availability zones of the VPC.Created NAT gateways and instances to allow communication from the private instances to the internet through bastion hosts.
Used security groups, network ACL’s, internet gateways and route tables to ensure a secure zone for organization in AWS public cloud.
Created and configured elastic load balancers and auto scaling groups to distribute the traffic and to have a cost efficient, fault tolerant and highly available environment.
Used IAM for creating roles, users, groups and also implemented MFA to provide additional security to AWS account and its resources.
Written cloud formation templates in json to create custom VPC, subnets, NAT to ensure successful deployment of web applications.
Implemented domain name service (DNS) through route 53 to have highly available and scalable applications.
Maintained the monitoring and alerting of production and corporate servers using Cloud Watch service.
Experienced in creating RDS instances to serve data through servers for responding to requests.
Responsible for Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery process implementation using Jenkins along with Python and Shell scripts to automate routine jobs.
Responsible for performing tasks like Branching, Tagging, and Release Activities on Version Control Tools like SVN, GIT.
Environment: AWS (EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, EBS, RDS, Route53, ELB, Cloud Watch, CloudFormation, AWS Auto Scaling, Lambda, Elastic BeanStalk), GIT, SQL, Jira, AWS CLI, Unix/Linux
